info.name: 📌 IBM watsonx.ai API
info.description:
### About IBM WatsonX AI

"A next generation enterprise studio for AI builders to train, validate, tune and deploy AI models"

IBM builds its own Granite models and hosts models from other labs, such as Llama and Mistral, with a Model Gateway to further providers. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Cloud platforms**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- IBM Cloud Account: [https://dataplatform.cloud.ibm.com/login](https://dataplatform.cloud.ibm.com/login)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add these keys to your **Postman Vault** as `ibm_watsonx_api_key`, `openai_api_key`, `google_gemini_api_key`, `groq_api_key`, `xai_api_key`, `anthropic_api_key`, `cerebras_api_key`, `nvidia_api_key`, `amazon_bedrock_access_key_id`, `amazon_bedrock_secret_access_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using these exact names). Requests read them as `{{vault:ibm_watsonx_api_key}}` and so on, so your key never leaves your device. Also set your watsonx project in the `projectId` collection variable, and send **identity/token** first to get the `access_token`.

### Documentation

- API: [https://cloud.ibm.com/apidocs/machine-learning](https://cloud.ibm.com/apidocs/machine-learning)
    
- Models: [https://www.ibm.com/products/watsonx-ai/foundation-models](https://www.ibm.com/products/watsonx-ai/foundation-models)

request.description:
## Add WatsonxAI Provider

This endpoint allows you to add a new WatsonxAI provider by sending a POST request to the specified URL.

### Endpoint

`POST {{modelGatewayUrl}}/providers/watsonxai`

### Request Body

The request should include a JSON payload with the following parameters:

- **name** (string): The name of the provider. For example, `"watsonxai-provider"`.
    
- **data** (object): An object containing the necessary configuration for the provider:
    
    - **apikey** (string): Your API key for authentication.
        
    - **project_id** (string): The ID of the project associated with the provider.
        
    - **base_url** (string): The base URL for the WatsonxAI service.
        

### Example Request

``` json
{
  "name": "watsonxai-provider",
  "data": {
    "apikey": "{{vault:ibm_watsonx_api_key}}",
    "project_id": "{{projectId}}",
    "base_url": "{{baseUrl}}"
  }
}

 ```

### Expected Response

Upon a successful request, the response will return a JSON object with the following fields:

- **uuid** (string): A unique identifier for the provider.
    
- **name** (string): The name of the provider that was added.
    
- **type** (string): The type of the provider.
    

### Example Response

``` json
{
  "uuid": "",
  "name": "",
  "type": ""
}

 ```

Ensure that all required parameters are included in the request body to successfully add the WatsonxAI provider.
